findings.statement: a thousand keys in the memtable cost the routed scan at least 3x
findings.detail: 49373281 entries/s routed against 27536184 with a thousand unsealed keys (routed vs routed+memtable: greater 1.793x (p=0.0122, rel_iqr 19.1%/12.1%)); the fast path over partitions is lost for every entry once any unsealed key lies past the scan's start

findings.statement: four level-0 segments without a memtable scan within 1.5x of the undrained shape
findings.detail: 21882796 entries/s undrained (three segments and the memtable) against 29258296 with four segments and no memtable (undrained vs four-l0: less 0.748x (p=0.0122, rel_iqr 23.9%/3.2%)); the level-0 count is the cost

findings.statement: the undrained shape scans at least 5x slower than routed
findings.detail: 49373281 entries/s routed against 21882796 undrained (routed vs undrained: greater 2.256x (p=0.0122, rel_iqr 19.1%/23.9%)), EXT.39's 8.6x inside one process

notes: four arms interleaved, the same ordered load each rep, the store left in four shapes: routed (flush); routed plus a thousand keys in the memtable; four level-0 segments and no memtable (seal, no partitioning); undrained (three segments and the memtable). Then ordered scans from random starts; entries per second
